bullets: • SBI ELSS Tax Advantage Fund carries an exit load of 0%, meaning no exit load fee is charged upon redemption, as the fund enforces a mandatory 3-year lock-in period instead.

• The lock-in period of 3 years for SBI ELSS Tax Advantage Fund means investors cannot redeem units before the lock-in ends, making the exit load structure effectively replaced by the statutory lock-in restriction.
• The expense ratio for SBI Large Cap Fund Direct Plan is typically in the range of 0.5–0.9% per annum, which is deducted from the fund's Net Asset Value (NAV) on an ongoing basis.
• Regular plans of SBI Mutual Fund schemes carry a higher expense ratio compared to direct plans, as the additional cost accounts for distributor commissions paid to intermediaries.
• Securities Transaction Tax (STT) of 0.001% is applicable on equity mutual fund redemptions, which is a government-mandated tax separate from the fund's exit load or expense ratio.
• SEBI mandates full disclosure of the Total Expense Ratio (TER) for all mutual fund schemes, ensuring transparency for investors regarding all costs associated with a fund.
